Package com.kerosene.kfe.ledger.adapters.out.persistence.settlement

Class KfeFeeSettlementService

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.ledger.adapters.out.persistence.settlement.KfeFeeSettlementService
@Service public class KfeFeeSettlementService extends Object
Settles Kerosene fee to SYSTEM_PROFIT wallet (ITEM 10 — profit segregation).

PROFIT SEGREGATION MODEL (SUBLEDGER): Fees are credited to SYSTEM_PROFIT as a ledger entry within the USERS bucket. This is accounting-only — there is no physical UTXO segregation. The SYSTEM_PROFIT balance is a LIABILITY within USERS until physically moved to a dedicated vault PROFIT bucket.

INVARIANT: userDebit = recipientCredit + revenueCredit + networkFee Every settled transaction must preserve this identity. No sats created or destroyed.

CONFIGURATION: kfe.profit.segregation-mode=SUBLEDGER (default). Future modes: DEDICATED_BUCKET (separate vault bucket), PERIODIC_TRANSFER.

RECONCILIATION: When kfe.profit.reconcile-with-vault=true, the SYSTEM_PROFIT balance is included in solvency calculations. Total assets must cover user liabilities + SYSTEM_PROFIT balance + safety buffer.

  • Method Details

    • creditKeroseneFee

      public void creditKeroseneFee(KfeTransactionEntity tx)
      Credits the Kerosene fee from a settled transaction to the SYSTEM_PROFIT wallet.

      PROFIT INVARIANT: Every fee credit preserves the identity: userDebit = recipientCredit + keroseneFee + networkFee

      Idempotent: dual inbound paths / retries must not inflate SYSTEM_PROFIT.

      SEGREGATION: In SUBLEDGER mode, profit is tracked in the ledger but remains part of the USERS bucket's backing assets. It is a liability until physically transferred to a dedicated vault PROFIT bucket.

      CHANNEL COST ATTRIBUTION: Channel operations (open/close/rebalance) consume on-chain fees. These MUST NOT accidentally consume USERS backing. Channel costs are tracked via KfeChannelLifecycleService and attributed to CHANNELS or INFRA buckets.

    • reverseKeroseneFeeForReorg

      public void reverseKeroseneFeeForReorg(KfeTransactionEntity tx)
      Reverses a previously credited fee once when its inbound transaction is reorganized out. The movement is recorded before balance mutation; any amount no longer available becomes reorg debt.
      Parameters:
      tx - transaction whose fee posting is being reversed; null or incomplete transactions are ignored

    • restoreKeroseneFeeAfterReorg

      public void restoreKeroseneFeeAfterReorg(KfeTransactionEntity tx)
      Restores a fee after a reorg only when a reversal exists and no restore has already been recorded.
      Parameters:
      tx - transaction whose previously reversed fee is being restored; invalid inputs are ignored
